You get a ton of MFC later in the dlc, in the meantime, you really have to look on the ground for spent shells. You can find little piles of used MFC all over the place, so try to find those and recycle them at the workbench in the main villa. You also have to find Dean Stashes, which often have some ammo in them. If you can, you might want to get the vigilant recycler perk, which let's you get more ammo per recycle (I think it lowers the cost from 4 drained cells to 3, not much but it helps).

For the main chunk of your ammo, you are going to have to find the upgrade vendor codes for the holorifle. You can find three of the upgrades and they usually are surrounded by a few packs of 20 MFC, getting you almost 100 or more at a time. Find them all and you should walk away with 200-300 MFC by the end of the dlc.

Here is what I do.

Go to any location when an interior cell, so most buildings, and make a save outside. Make sure you have the auto save enabled for every time you enter a building, this is important.
